_comment: Scripted-input demo: box-select three regiments (uids 0/1/2 — Spearmen 140, Infantry 120, Archers 90, spawned in a row at y=300 on seed 12345), then one right-drag deploys them along a flank line, split to equal depth. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; in-transit samples fire the grid metrics (same-owner bodies pass arbitrarily close mid-re-slot by design -- intra-regiment spacing is the formation arrival's job, not steering's -- and routes cross while the grid re-deals). Measured on the new-density re-pin: min neighbour 0.19 wu during the three-regiment drag-line deploy.

Measured on the new-density re-pin: 0.45 crossing fraction during the deploy re-deal.
